ctx.x: Any way, and we had --'Autumn Leaves', that's it. And they had a monologue on here, some man by the name of Tom Scott. Yes, it was -- he was -- I guess it was a great recording. Yeah, yeah, very good recording. But any way I enjoyed working with Artie because we'd have some sessions or just gab fests. We'd rehearse a while and we'd talk most of the time. The whole group. And of course Joe Benjamin, boy, that was -- he loved that, because he would get into these heated conversations,he and Billy -- well, we all…
You and Joe were very good friends.
